rounds.text: Encompass Design India Ltd currently trades at a significant premium to its sector, with a P/E of 26.35x compared to the 17.45x benchmark and a P/B of 4.14x against a 1.38x sector average [E6, E7]. This valuation disconnect is further highlighted by an EV/EBITDA of 16.23x, which substantially exceeds the sector benchmark of 10.22x [E11]. While the company reports profits, it fails to return capital to shareholders, maintaining a dividend yield of 0.00% [E4, E39]. Operational efficiency is also under pressure, as evidenced by working capital days increasing from 60.8 to 93.4 days [E40] and inconsistent operating margins over the last three quarters [E22]. Furthermore, the company reported a negative free cash flow of Rs -27 Cr in March 2026 [E25], and institutional interest is waning, with both foreign and domestic institutions reducing their holdings since December 2025 [E30, E31]. Conceded: the company demonstrates strong historical growth metrics, including a 47% compounded sales growth over three years [E14] and a robust ROCE of 25.6% [E12].
